title: checkout.completeWithAirlineCard: sent once, never echoed
caption: The hosted storefront's card form (cookie mode). The route table marks the operation retry: never with a 90 s timeout; the session does not resend it after TOKEN_EXPIRED or CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID; an error is rebuilt without any card value (namespaces/checkout.js withoutCard). Key callers get 403 SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED (edge_only).

steps.label: core.call(op.checkout_completeWithAirlineCard) — new Idempotency-Key, timeout 90 s, maxRetries forced to 0
Flight Create Orders with the card as form of payment, issue = true
on 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED: refresh for the NEXT submit, then throw (mayResend = false)

withoutCard(error): drop card-named fields from details/supplier, redact number, last 12 digits, CVC, holder name; drop a cause that holds any of them; replace an error that is not a VelexisError and holds any of them by a plain Error
result, or the scrubbed error (same class, code, status, requestId)
steps.note: After 504 SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT, a timeout or a network error the order may exist: show the pending booking (details.bookingId), never send the card again.
